introHtml: Unisex pocket utility knives offer a balanced design that fits comfortably in any hand, making them ideal for safety managers and HR directors equipping diverse teams. Choose from imprint options like laser engraving or pad printing to add your logo. They ship flat for easy customization and bulk distribution.
